# U177: Goals filtered by a workspace’s own field (TG2): as Amara, with Stage on two goals, the Filters sheet has a Stage row (Discover · Build · Run · Not set); ticking Build lists Flaky test rate and not Base image build time, the filter line says “Stage is Build” with Remove, and the address carries it; saved as a view “Building”, plain Goals and then the view bring the same goals back, and Data’s Goals table has a Stage column

- **Belongs to:** the Fields module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `TAGS-FILTER`, `SAVED-VIEWS`
- **Budget:** at most 16 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U177

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Fields' journeys (`seedStage`).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Filter(s / and sort)” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “Filter(s / and sort)” button.
- **Check:** The “Stage” group in the “Filter goals” dialog shows.
- **Check:** (`parity`) met when `/Stage.*Discover.*Build.*Run.*Not set/.test(words)`, where `const sheet = p.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Filter goals' })`; `const row = sheet.getByRole('group', { name: 'Stage' })`; `const words = (await row.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`. Else it says: the Stage row says “{words}”.
- **Step.** Press the “Build” field in the “Stage” group in the “Filter goals” dialog.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “filters”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Show the goals” button in the “Filter goals” dialog.
- **Check:** The “Remove the filter Stage is Build” button shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) the “Remove the filter Stage is Build” button is visible (else: the filter line does not say “Stage is Build” with Remove).
- **Check:** “Flaky test rate in the main pipelines” is shown (else: the goal in Build is not listed).
- _Note:_ Fields' filters load once the workspace has a field (not with the first download): the list narrows when they have.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `!(await listed()) && /[?&]f\.fld_stage=Build/.test(p.url())`, where `const listed = async () => { await p.locator('main').getByText('Base image build time').first().waitFor({ state: 'hidden', timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => {}); return (await p.locator('main').innerText()).includes('Base image build time'); }`. Else it says: the goal in Discover is listed, or the address ({p.url()}) does not carry the filter.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “filtered”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Saved as a view: the parameter goes with it, and the view brings the goals back.
- **Step.** Choose “Save this view…” in the Views menu (the View sheet on a phone).
- **Step.** Type “Building” into the “Name” field in the “Save this view” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Save view” button in the “Save this view” dialog.
- **Check:** The “Save this view” dialog goes away.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `(s.views ?? []).some((v) => v.name === 'Building' && v.params.includes('f.fld_stage=Build') && !v.deletedAt)`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the view was not saved with the Stage filter.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Base image build time” is shown (else: plain Goals does not list every goal).
- **Step.** Open the saved view “Building” (the Views menu; the View sheet’s Saved views on a phone).
- **Check:** “Flaky test rate in the main pipelines” is shown (else: opening the view does not list the goal in Build).
- **Check:** The “Remove the filter Stage is Build” button shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!(await listed()) && await back.isVisible()`, where `const listed = async () => { await p.locator('main').getByText('Base image build time').first().waitFor({ state: 'hidden', timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => {}); return (await p.locator('main').innerText()).includes('Base image build time'); }`; `const back = p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove the filter Stage is Build' })`. Else it says: the view did not bring the Stage filter back.
- _Note:_ Data's Goals table: a column per live field.
- Go to `/data?t=goals` in the demo.
- **Check:** The table in the main (`main table`) shows.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `(await p.locator('main table thead').first().innerText()).includes('Stage')`. Else it says: Data’s Goals table has no Stage column.
- Close this browser.
